hero.heroIntroOne: Silence here is not an absence, but a presence in itself.
hero.heroIntroTwo: Leave the urban noise at the entrance and give yourself the luxury of finding your own natural rhythm.

heroOpen.headline: The lost art of stopping.
heroOpen.content: No schedules, no notifications, no rush. Just you, your rhythm, and nature.
heroOpen.textLeft: Luxury is not in things, but in presence.

textApop: You will arrive with the city's clamor still clinging to you. The first impression may be almost a shock: no cars, no sirens—just a sanctuary where time appears to have stood still. Give yourself two hours. That is how long it takes for your breath to sync with the rhythm of the hills. Then, the magic happens: you will stop rushing and begin to truly feel.
textSectionB: True luxury is stopping to gaze at something that changes constantly while remaining still. At the core of Ca' Perenzin lies the fireplace. Forget the glare of screens or ambient noise; here, only the warm glow of the fire dances, reshaping the shadows around you.
subHeadlineD: Many dread the deep dark of the hills. What becomes of us without the city lights?
noteD: You won't be bored. You will rediscover the art of speaking softly and holding hands.

star.headline: The Infinite
star.content: The answer lies above you. Without light pollution, the sky returns to its ancient state: a carpet of stars so sharp you will feel as if you are falling into them.

moon.headline: The Silver
moon.content: On full moon nights, the valley lights up with a silver glow so powerful you can walk without torches.

rain.headline: The Rhythm
rain.content: This is when the shelter becomes a den. The sound of water on the roof becomes a hypnotic lullaby, a rhythm that induces the deepest sleep you have ever known.

sectionF.paragraphOne: No electronic 'beeps'. Your awakening has only one sound: the slow gurgle of the Moka pot rising. And it has only one scent: that of a freshly baked cake, smelling of butter, sugar, and patience.
sectionF.paragraphTwo: In the small lounge, the fireplace is not a piece of furniture, it is a companion. Its warmth is not the dry air of an air conditioner, but an embrace that wraps around your shoulders. It is the breakfast of your childhood. Simple, homemade, infinitely good.

content.paragraphOne: You will find nothing here that hasn't touched the soil of our hills. The morning begins with the imperfect and sincere texture of our tarts, kneaded by hand while you are still sleeping.
content.paragraphTwo: Savor 'Mother Earth': eggs that taste of sun, fruit that follows only the calendar of the seasons, and Perenzin cheeses that tell ancient stories. It is a clean, healthy taste, devoid of preservatives.
content.paragraphThree: It is the honest flavor of the past, the kind that nourishes not just the body, but the memory.

content.paragraphOne: On mornings when the air outside bites, in here time slows down to a halt. Our lounge with the fireplace is not a simple space: it is a shelter within a shelter. Imagine the crackling of wood as the only soundtrack.
content.paragraphTwo: The heat coloring your cheeks. An infusion of positive energy in your hands. It is a primitive and rare luxury: enjoying the silence while the fire dances, feeling finally safe, protected from the whole world.

sectionI.headline: Beyond the gate, a world of magic.

sectionL.content: To understand these hills, it is not enough to watch them from a window: you must breathe them. Smell the cut grass, feel the temperature drop in the shade of a wood, hear the sound of gravel under your wheels. With our E-Bikes, climbs become gentle plains and the landscape enters you. The true luxury? No logistics.

cardOne.headline: Adrenaline and Peaks
cardOne.content: From the Revine lakes where kitesurfers fly, to the ancient forests of Cansiglio and the peaks of the Dolomites. For those seeking the deep breath of happy fatigue.

cardTwo.headline: Hidden Treasures
cardTwo.content: Medieval villages like Cison and Follina, thousand-year-old castles and secret panoramic points like the Giant Bench. We will reveal the corners only locals know.

cardThree.headline: Soul and Taste
cardThree.content: Not just Prosecco. A journey through historic wineries, award-winning Perenzin cheeses and small artisan shops. For those who want to taste the history of these hills.

sectionN.headline: Far from the world, close to everything.

info.title: The fast route with Airlink
info.text: Canova airport is tiny and super convenient. Just outside the terminal, look for the Treviso Airlink (the red bus). It is a dedicated service taking you directly to Central Station with no stops. Once on the train, you will be in Conegliano in just 15 minutes.

info.title: The smoothest way from the Lagoon
info.text: From Marco Polo Airport, avoid entering Venice island. The secret is taking the ATVO Fly Bus shuttle directly to Venice Mestre station (Mainland). From there, trains to Conegliano leave every 20 minutes and get you to your destination in less than half an hour.

infoBox.title: THE WATER SALON
infoBox.text: Often underestimated, Treviso is a jewel of canals and frescoed arcades that we locals love deeply. It is the perfect destination for a relaxing afternoon:
dotList: What to do: Get lost in the Buranelli canals, shop in the downtown boutiques and taste the real Tiramisù (born here!).
How to go: Forget the car and parking. From Conegliano station a train leaves about every 20 minutes. In less than half an hour you'll be in the center, ready for an aperitif.

buttons.label: Arrived by train?
buttons.text: If your departure city doesn't have a direct line to Conegliano, Treviso Centrale is a very convenient hub. Connections to Conegliano are fast and frequent until late evening.

infoBox.title: WORRY-FREE VENICE
infoBox.text: Many tourists make the mistake of driving to Venice, ending up trapped in traffic and paying crazy sums for Piazzale Roma parking. The winning strategy is starting from here:
dotList: The right move: Leave your car comfortably at Conegliano station (15 min from us).
The journey: Enjoy 45 minutes of relaxation on the train.
The magical arrival: You will get off at Santa Lucia station, which overlooks the Grand Canal directly. No bus, no transfer. You are already inside the postcard.

buttons.label: The timing trick
buttons.text: Catch the fast regional train at 9:02 or 9:30. You will arrive with the perfect morning light, avoiding the dawn commuter rush. And for the return? Trains run until late evening, enjoy dinner there.

infoBox.title: THE CONEGLIANO HUB
infoBox.text: Conegliano station is the real logistical hub of the area. Just 15 minutes by car from the B&B, it is served by all main trains (Fast Regionals and Frecce).
dotList: Parking: Large and convenient right in front of the tracks.
Transfer: Don't have a car? Taxis are always available in the square, or ask us for our trusted driver's contact.

dataRooms.carousellContent: Our highest dwelling, with wooden ceilings warming the atmosphere. Generous spaces and a dominant view of the Visentin, to gather those you love in a single embrace.
dataRooms.description: The heart is the organ that never rests, the one that gives rhythm to life. This room was designed with the same principle: to be the vital center of your stay. Wider and more generous in spaces, the Heart Room is thought for sharing. It is the place where laughter bounces off the walls, where you meet at the end of the day to tell each other the discoveries made in the hills. Here architecture favors union without sacrificing freedom of movement. It is a warm, vibrant space, where you feel like family — however you define this word.

experience.headline: KiteSurf at the Lakes
experience.content: Here, the clock is useless; you just need to feel the air. Punctual every afternoon, the thermal wind transforms this turquoise mirror of water into an arena of pure adrenaline. Lake Santa Croce is the natural gym for kitesurfers: flat water, constant wind, and the Alpago peaks framing you. Whether you are experts ready to jump or beginners wanting to learn to fly on water, this is your destination.

tips.contentOne: The best wind usually picks up after 1:00 PM.
tips.contentTwo: The VKC school is located in the Farra d'Alpago/Poiatte area, excellent for equipment rental.

experience.headline: Swing in the Clouds
experience.content: Forget golf courses manicured like urban gardens. Here, you play with wild nature. At 1,000 meters altitude, the Cansiglio Golf Club is considered one of the most beautiful mountain courses in Europe. A natural 'Links' course where holes hide among karst sinkholes and fairways are walls of centuries-old beech trees. The air is crisp even in August; the silence is broken only by the sound of the driver. A technical challenge for players, a walk in beauty for companions.

tips.contentTwo: Polo/golf attire required (it is a historic and respected club).

experience.headline: The Alpine Beat
experience.content: The mountain is not just to be watched, but listened to. Dolomiti Beat is your pass to the peaks. A team of professional guides ready to take you where normal trails don't reach: from the ancient forests of Cansiglio to the spires of the Dolomites. Whether it's a sunrise trek, a snowshoe hike under the full moon, or an adrenaline-filled E-Bike outing, with them exploration is safe, narrated, and unforgettable. No maps needed, just the desire to walk.

tips.contentOne: They have a fixed calendar but also organize private outings on request.
tips.contentTwo: They often provide snowshoes or poles.

experience.headline: The Yellow Giant
experience.content: Returning to being children for a moment. This is the promise of Big Bench #181, a huge sun-yellow bench overlooking the two lakes of Revine. Sitting here, with dangling legs not touching the ground, changes your perspective on the world. Below you, the mirror of water; in front, the amphitheater of the Prealps. Expert tip: On clear days, sharpen your sight towards the hills to the west: you might spot the profile of the mountain where the Winged Lion you just visited rests.

tips.contentOne: If guests have the 'Big Bench Passport', they can get it stamped in local village premises.
tips.contentTwo: Perfect for aperitif time (bringing a bottle in your backpack).

experience.headline: The Mirror of the Prealps
experience.content: While the peaks challenge the sky, the Revine Lakes reflect it. Two water twins of glacial origin where time slows down. Here the experience is double: you can rent a pedal boat and dive into the swimmable waters, or travel back in time visiting the Livelet Archaeological Park, a stilt village suspended on water like 6,000 years ago. The perfect place for a lake-view picnic, far from the crowd.

tips.contentOne: Rent a pedal boat at sunset to see the mountains turn pink from the water.

experience.headline: The Winged Guardian
experience.content: Where the storm destroyed, art rebuilt. On the summit of Monte Simoni awaits the world's largest Winged Lion, sculpted entirely from the wood of trees felled by cyclone Vaia. It is not just a statue; it is a pilgrimage. It is reached via a steep path among the vineyards, but the reward is double: coming face to face with the majesty of 1,500 wooden fragments and dominating the entire arc of the UNESCO hills with a single glance.

tips.contentOne: Ideal at sunset for the golden light on the wood.

experience.headline: The Living Postcard
experience.content: It looks like a painting, but it is all real. The Molinetto della Croda is a jewel of 17th-century rural architecture, carved into the bare rock and caressed by a waterfall. Here, time has the slow rhythm of the stone millstone which, still today, transforms corn into golden flour. It is the place where the millers' toil became poetry. Visiting it means entering the ancient heart of our hills, amidst the scent of flour and the sound of water.

tips.contentOne: They often sell flour ground on-site.
tips.contentTwo: Very beautiful nature trails depart from here along the Lierza stream.

experience.headline: SPA Castel Brando
experience.content: Imagine immersing yourself in hot water surrounded by ancient walls. The Princess SPA of CastelBrando is not a simple wellness center, but a journey through time. Located inside one of the oldest castles in Europe, it offers 2,000 sqm of relaxation where history meets steam: ancient Roman baths, saunas, counter-current swimming pool, and a Himalayan salt cave. Here, you don't just relax as guests, but as nobles of the court.

tips.contentTwo: There is also a private 'Spa Suite' for couples.

experience.headline: The Cloister of Silence
experience.content: If silence had an architectural form, it would be the cloister of Follina. In this Cistercian masterpiece of the 12th century, the stone seems to have been embroidered like lace. Walking along the quadriporticus, observing the play of light between the columns, all different from each other, is a form of moving meditation. A place where time stops, perfect for finding that inner peace we often seek in vain elsewhere.

tips.contentTwo: Visits to the cloister and basilica are usually free.

experience.headline: The Giant of the Hills
experience.content: Dominating the horizon for nearly a thousand years. San Salvatore is not just a castle; it is a living fortress of the Collalto family. A double circle of walls embraces palaces and hanging gardens, offering a dive into history and a view that, on clear days, reaches as far as Venice.

tips.contentOne: Check openings: it is a private residence visible only on specific dates or by reservation.
tips.contentTwo: If closed, the Conte Collalto Winery at the foot of the fortress will welcome you with the same nobility.

experience.headline: The White Gold
experience.content: If cheese is a religion, this is its sanctuary. For five generations, the Perenzin family has been transforming milk into world-award-winning art. Forget the old dairy shop: the 'PER' is a modern Cheese Bar where tasting is a sensory journey. Here, a cheese excites as much as a great wine.

tips.contentOne: Don't miss the 'San Pietro in beeswax', a masterpiece.
tips.contentTwo: Book a guided tasting to understand the secrets of affinage.

experience.headline: The Soul of Wine
experience.content: You don't come here just to drink, but to understand. The Antoniazzi family cultivates heroic vineyards on impossible slopes to give you a Prosecco DOCG that has character to spare. Their winery is a glass-walled lounge immersed in greenery, where wine is narrated with passion. A tasting experience that explains, better than a thousand words, what 'heroic viticulture' means.

tips.contentOne: Do not miss their goose salami and 'Oca in onto', a true Slow Food presidium.
tips.contentTwo: Ask to taste their reds as well, rare for this area.

experience.headline: The Stone Lounge
experience.content: A 19th-century farmhouse that has changed its skin. Ca' Piadera combines the raw stone of Nogarolo with contemporary and refined design. Here, Venetian cuisine wears its Sunday best: hand-rolled pasta and garden flavors served with surprising elegance. It is the perfect refuge for those seeking the substance of tradition without sacrificing style.

tips.contentOne: In summer, book in the 'brolo' to dine among the vine rows.
tips.contentTwo: Try their gourmet 'cicchetti' with the house Prosecco.

experience.headline: The Keeper of the Fire
experience.content: Since 1919, this has been the steadfast point of local cuisine. At Ai Pini, they don't follow trends; they honor memory. The heart of the room is the ancient open fireplace ('larin'), where meat is still cooked over live embers right before your eyes. It is the Sunday family restaurant, with reassuring flavors: from 'soppressa' with polenta to salt cod, to mixed grills smelling of wood smoke. An honest place, where hospitality has been managed by the same family for three generations.

tips.contentOne: If you love meat, their fireplace-grilled selection is essential (ask for a table near the fire in winter).
tips.contentTwo: In the warm season, book under the outdoor pergola: you dine in the cool air with a relaxing view of the hills.

experience.headline: The Invisible Host
experience.content: An Iconic Experience! Here, the host is the landscape itself. In this farmhouse perched among the most precious vineyards in the world (the Cartizze), the ancient rule of trust prevails. You enter, serve yourself by taking a bottle and a platter from the fridge, leave your offering in the box, and go out to enjoy the show. There are no assigned chairs: your table is a tree trunk or a vine row facing infinity. It is the apotheosis of Venetian freedom: bread, wine, and a breathtaking horizon.

tips.contentOne: Parking is down in the valley: be prepared for a short but steep uphill walk among the vineyards.
tips.contentTwo: The best moment is the golden hour at sunset, when the Cartizze hills are literally dyed with light.

privacy.title: PRIVACY NOTICE
intro: This Privacy Notice for Ca' Perenzin ("we," "us," or "our"), describes how and why we might access, collect, store, use, and/or share ("process") your personal information when you use our services ("Services"), including when you:

Questions or concerns? Reading this Privacy Notice will help you understand your privacy rights and choices. We are responsible for making decisions about how your personal information is processed. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our Services.

sections.title: SUMMARY OF KEY POINTS
sections.content: This summary provides key points from our Privacy Notice, but you can find out more details about any of these topics by clicking the link following each key point or by using our table of contents below to find the section you are looking for.
list: What personal information do we process? When you visit, use, or navigate our Services, we may process personal information depending on how you interact with us and the Services, the choices you make, and the products and features you use.

Do we process any sensitive personal information? Some of the information may be considered "special" or "sensitive" in certain jurisdictions, for example your racial or ethnic origins, sexual orientation, and religious beliefs. We do not process sensitive personal information.
Do we collect any information from third parties? We may collect information from public databases, marketing partners, social media platforms, and other outside sources.

How do we process your information? We process your information to provide, improve, and administer our Services, communicate with you, for security and fraud prevention, and to comply with law. We may also process your information for other purposes with your consent. We process your information only when we have a valid legal reason to do so.
In what situations and with which parties do we share personal information? We may share information in specific situations and with specific third parties.
What are your rights? Depending on where you are located geographically, the applicable privacy law may mean you have certain rights regarding your personal information.

How do you exercise your rights? The easiest way to exercise your rights is by submitting a data subject access request, or by contacting us. We will consider and act upon any request in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
Want to learn more about what we do with any information we collect? Review the Privacy Notice in full.

sections.title: 1. WHAT INFORMATION DO WE COLLECT?
sections.content:
Personal information you disclose to us
In Short: We collect personal information that you provide to us.
We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you register on the Services, express an interest in obtaining information about us or our products and Services, when you participate in activities on the Services, or otherwise when you contact us.
Sensitive Information. We do not process sensitive information.
All personal information that you provide to us must be true, complete, and accurate, and you must notify us of any changes to such personal information.

Information automatically collected
In Short: Some information — such as your Internet Protocol (IP) address and/or browser and device characteristics — is collected automatically when you visit our Services.
We automatically collect certain information when you visit, use, or navigate the Services. This information does not reveal your specific identity (like your name or contact information) but may include device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location, information about how and when you use our Services, and other technical information. This information is primarily needed to maintain the security and operation of our Services, and for our internal analytics and reporting purposes.
Like many businesses, we also collect information through cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: 2. HOW DO WE PROCESS YOUR INFORMATION?
sections.content:
In Short: We process your information to provide, improve, and administer our Services, communicate with you, for security and fraud prevention, and to comply with law. We may also process your information for other purposes with your consent.
We process your personal information for a variety of reasons, depending on how you interact with our Services.

sections.title: 3. WHEN AND WITH WHOM DO WE SHARE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?
sections.content:
In Short: We may share information in specific situations described in this section and/or with the following third parties.
We may need to share your personal information in the following situations:
list: Business Transfers. We may share or transfer your information in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business to another company.

Affiliates. We may share your information with our affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Notice. Affiliates include our parent company and any subsidiaries, joint venture partners, or other companies that we control or that are under common control with us.
Business Partners. We may share your information with our business partners to offer you certain products, services, or promotions.

sections.title: 4. DO WE USE COOKIES AND OTHER TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES?
sections.content:
In Short: We may use cookies and other tracking technologies to collect and store your information.
We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies (like web beacons and pixels) to gather information when you interact with our Services. Some online tracking technologies help us maintain the security of our Services, prevent crashes, fix bugs, save your preferences, and assist with basic site functions.
We also permit third parties and service providers to use online tracking technologies on our Services for analytics and advertising, including to help manage and display advertisements, to tailor advertisements to your interests, or to send abandoned shopping cart reminders (depending on your communication preferences). The third parties and service providers use their technology to provide advertising about products and services tailored to your interests which may appear either on our Services or on other websites.
Specific information about how we use such technologies and how you can refuse certain cookies is set out in our Cookie Notice.

sections.title: 5. HOW DO WE HANDLE YOUR SOCIAL LOGINS?
sections.content:
In Short: If you choose to register or log in to our Services using a social media account, we may have access to certain information about you.
Our Services offer you the ability to register and log in using your third-party social media account details (like your Facebook or X logins). Where you choose to do this, we will receive certain profile information about you from your social media provider. The profile information we receive may vary depending on the social media provider concerned, but will often include your name, email address, friends list, and profile picture, as well as other information you choose to make public on such a social media platform.
We will use the information we receive only for the purposes that are described in this Privacy Notice or that are otherwise made clear to you on the relevant Services. Please note that we do not control, and are not responsible for, other uses of your personal information by your third-party social media provider. We recommend that you review their privacy notice to understand how they collect, use, and share your personal information, and how you can set your privacy preferences on their sites and apps.

sections.title: 6. IS YOUR INFORMATION TRANSFERRED INTERNATIONALLY?
sections.content:
In Short: We may transfer, store, and process your information in countries other than your own.
Our servers are located in Italy. Regardless of your location, please be aware that your information may be transferred to, stored by, and processed by us in our facilities and in the facilities of the third parties with whom we may share your personal information (see "WHEN AND WITH WHOM DO WE SHARE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?" above), including facilities in and other countries.
If you are a resident in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom (UK), or Switzerland, then these countries may not necessarily have data protection laws or other similar laws as comprehensive as those in your country. However, we will take all necessary measures to protect your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Notice and applicable law.

sections.title: 7. HOW LONG DO WE KEEP YOUR INFORMATION?
sections.content:
In Short: We keep your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Notice unless otherwise required by law.
We will only keep your personal information for as long as it is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Notice, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law (such as tax, accounting, or other legal requirements).
When we have no ongoing legitimate business need to process your personal information, we will either delete or anonymize such information, or, if this is not possible (for example, because your personal information has been stored in backup archives), then we will securely store your personal information and isolate it from any further processing until deletion is possible.

sections.title: 8. DO WE COLLECT INFORMATION FROM MINORS?
sections.content:
In Short: We do not knowingly collect data from or market to children under 18 years of age.
We do not knowingly collect, solicit data from, or market to children under 18 years of age, nor do we knowingly sell such personal information. By using the Services, you represent that you are at least 18 or that you are the parent or guardian of such a minor and consent to such minor dependent’s use of the Services. If we learn that personal information from users less than 18 years of age has been collected, we will deactivate the account and take reasonable measures to promptly delete such data from our records. If you become aware of any data we may have collected from children under age 18, please contact us at info@caperenzin.it.

sections.title: 9. WHAT ARE YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS?
sections.content:
In Short: You may review, change, or terminate your account at any time, depending on your country, province, or state of residence.
Withdrawing your consent: If we are relying on your consent to process your personal information, which may be express and/or implied consent depending on the applicable law, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us by using the contact details provided in the section "HOW CAN YOU CONTACT US ABOUT THIS NOTICE?" below.
However, please note that this will not affect the lawfulness of the processing before its withdrawal nor, when applicable law allows, will it affect the processing of your personal information conducted in reliance on lawful processing grounds other than consent.
Account Information: If you would at any time like to review or change the information in your account or terminate your account, you can. Upon your request to terminate your account, we will deactivate or delete your account and information from our active databases. However, we may retain some information in our files to prevent fraud, troubleshoot problems, assist with any investigations, enforce our legal terms and/or comply with applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 10. CONTROLS FOR DO-NOT-TRACK FEATURES
sections.content: Most web browsers and some mobile operating systems and mobile applications include a Do-Not-Track ("DNT") feature or setting you can activate to signal your privacy preference not to have data about your online browsing activities monitored and collected. At this stage, no uniform technology standard for recognizing and implementing DNT signals has been finalized. As such, we do not currently respond to DNT browser signals or any other mechanism that automatically communicates your choice not to be tracked online. If a standard for online tracking is adopted that we must follow in the future, we will inform you about that practice in a revised version of this Privacy Notice.

sections.title: 11. DO WE MAKE UPDATES TO THIS NOTICE?
sections.content:
In Short: Yes, we will update this notice as necessary to stay compliant with relevant laws.
We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated "Revised" date at the top of this Privacy Notice. If we make material changes to this Privacy Notice, we may notify you either by prominently posting a notice of such changes or by directly sending you a notification. We encourage you to review this Privacy Notice frequently to be informed of how we are protecting your information.

sections.title: 12. HOW CAN YOU CONTACT US ABOUT THIS NOTICE?
sections.content:
If you have questions or comments about this notice, you may contact us by post at:

Ca' Perenzin

cookie.title: COOKIE POLICY
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Ca' Perenzin ("Company," "we," "us," and "our") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our website at https://caperenzin.it ("Website"). sections.title: What are cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies are widely used by website owners in order to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.
sections.extraContent: Cookies set by the website owner (in this case, Ca' Perenzin) are called "first-party cookies." Cookies set by parties other than the website owner are called "third-party cookies." Third-party cookies enable third-party features or functionality to be provided on or through the website (e.g., advertising, interactive content, and analytics). The parties that set these third-party cookies can recognize your computer both when it visits the website in question and also when it visits certain other websites.

sections.title: Why do we use cookies?
sections.content: We use first- and third-party cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons in order for our Website to operate, and we refer to these as "essential" or "strictly necessary" cookies. Other cookies also enable us to track and target the interests of our users to enhance the experience on our Online Properties. Third parties serve cookies through our Website for advertising, analytics, and other purposes. This is described in more detail below.

sections.title: How can I control cookies?
sections.content: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can exercise your cookie rights by setting your preferences in the Cookie Preference Center. The Cookie Preference Center allows you to select which categories of cookies you accept or reject. Essential cookies cannot be rejected as they are strictly necessary to provide you with services.
sections.extraContent: The Cookie Preference Center can be found in the notification banner and on our Website. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our Website though your access to some functionality and areas of our Website may be restricted. You may also set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies.

sections.title: Essential website cookies:
sections.content: These cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with services available through our Website and to use some of its features, such as access to secure areas.

sections.title: What about other tracking technologies, like web beacons?
sections.content: Cookies are not the only way to recognize or track visitors to a website. We may use other, similar technologies from time to time, like web beacons (sometimes called "tracking pixels" or "clear gifs"). These are tiny graphics files that contain a unique identifier that enables us to recognize when someone has visited our Website or opened an email including them. This allows us, for example, to monitor the traffic patterns of users from one page within a website to another, to deliver or communicate with cookies, to understand whether you have come to the website from an online advertisement displayed on a third-party website, to improve site performance, and to measure the success of email marketing campaigns. In many instances, these technologies are reliant on cookies to function properly, and so declining cookies will impair their functioning.

sections.title: Do you use Flash cookies or Local Shared Objects?
sections.content: Websites may also use so-called "Flash Cookies" (also known as Local Shared Objects or "LSOs") to, among other things, collect and store information about your use of our services, fraud prevention, and for other site operations.
sections.extraContent: If you do not want Flash Cookies stored on your computer, you can adjust the settings of your Flash player to block Flash Cookies storage using the tools contained in the Website Storage Settings Panel. You can also control Flash Cookies by going to the Global Storage Settings Panel and following the instructions... Please note that setting the Flash Player to restrict or limit acceptance of Flash Cookies may reduce or impede the functionality of some Flash applications.

sections.title: Do you serve targeted advertising?
sections.content: Third parties may serve cookies on your computer or mobile device to serve advertising through our Website. These companies may use information about your visits to this and other websites in order to provide relevant advertisements about goods and services that you may be interested in. They may also employ technology that is used to measure the effectiveness of advertisements. They can accomplish this by using cookies or web beacons to collect information about your visits to this and other sites in order to provide relevant advertisements about goods and services of potential interest to you. The information collected through this process does not enable us or them to identify your name, contact details, or other details that directly identify you unless you choose to provide these.

sections.title: How often will you update this Cookie Policy?
sections.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please therefore revisit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies and related technologies.
sections.extraContent: The date at the top of this Cookie Policy indicates when it was last updated.
